description: Use only when a check finished with a carrier incomplete (reason no_call). Tell us whether you dialed it and what your calling platform reported: busy, no_answer, failed, rejected, connected, not_dialed or other, plus any SIP code (e.g. 603). It helps us find out why calls don't arrive; it's free and changes nothing about the check. Don't include personal information.

api_key.description: Optional API key (sia_...), if your connection has none and you got one from get_approval

note.description: Anything else that went wrong, without personal information

outcome.description: What your calling platform reported for the call

platform.description: Your calling platform, e.g. Twilio, Vapi, Retell

sip_code.description: The SIP response code, if your platform shows one

token.description: The token from start_check, for a check started without a key

name: report_call_problem
title: Tell us why a carrier got no call
